79afc889-dae2-4ea3-8b6f-54848a6b1ac0.en: I'm in my late 30s and tend to walk a lot when I go out with my kids on weekends. Comfort comes first for me with sneakers, so I usually wore New Balance or ASICS. This was my first DARIMATI purchase, and I got them because I liked SAND BEIGE. I ordered size 240, but the front of the shoe is pretty roomy, so they felt a little big at first. Once I adjusted the laces, though, they weren't particularly uncomfortable to walk in. I walked around the park with my kids for about two hours last weekend, and they were fine. These aren't shoes that feel super soft underfoot. I really like the design. The light color makes them a bit of a hassle to keep clean, but I think I'll wear them a lot for everyday outings.
79afc889-dae2-4ea3-8b6f-54848a6b1ac0.ja: 30代後半で、週末に子どもたちと出かけるときはよく歩くほう。スニーカーは履き心地優先で、普段はNew BalanceやASICSをよく履いていた。DARIMATIはSAND BEIGEの色が気に入って初めて購入。240を注文したけど、つま先側が広めなので最初は少し大きく感じた。でも紐をちゃんと調整すれば、歩くのにそこまで不便はなかった。この前の週末に子どもたちと公園で二時間くらい歩いたけど、特に問題なし。ソールがすごく柔らかく感じる靴ではない。デザインは本当に気に入っている。明るい色なので手入れはちょっと面倒だけど、普段のお出かけでよく履くことになりそう。

745442bb-f63d-4709-bee3-f6b533e7b218.en: Are sneakers allowed to be this cute lol I bought them for the gym, but lately I've been wearing them to work more haha They look good with beige slacks, and they're surprisingly not awkward with a dress either!! They were fine for workouts too, but the design is definitely my favorite thing about them❤️
745442bb-f63d-4709-bee3-f6b533e7b218.ja: スニーカーってこんなにかわいくていいの？笑笑 ジム用に買ったのに、最近は通勤で履くほうが多い笑 ベージュのスラックスにも合うし、ワンピースに合わせても思ったより違和感ない！！運動するときも普通によかったけど、私はとにかくデザインが一番お気に入り❤️

a8f98a25-13d5-4d04-a32e-8e5b31933338.en: I think comfort matters most in sneakers, so I mostly wore Skechers or New Balance. This was my first time buying DARIMATI, and I tried them because I liked the design. I mostly wear them for grocery shopping or walks. I like that there's room across the forefoot so my feet don't feel cramped. At first, the cushioning was firmer than I expected and felt a little unfamiliar, but I got used to it after a few days. I bought size 250, and there's a little extra room at the front for my feet. They seem to fit better with thick socks. They don't look overly sporty, so they go well with jeans too. I'm planning to wear them on our upcoming family trip. I don't know yet if they'll be comfortable for long days of traveling, but they're fine for everyday wear.
a8f98a25-13d5-4d04-a32e-8e5b31933338.ja: スニーカーは履き心地が一番だと思っていて、主にSkechersやNew Balanceを履いていた。DARIMATIはデザインが気に入って初めて買ってみた。主に買い物や散歩のときに履いている。足幅にゆとりがあって窮屈じゃないところがいい。最初は思ったよりクッションがしっかりしていて少し違和感があったけど、何日か履いたら慣れた。250を買ったけど、私の足だとつま先側は少し余裕がある。厚手の靴下を履くとより合う気がする。いかにも運動用というデザインじゃないので、ジーンズにもよく合う。今度の家族旅行に履いていこうと思っている。長時間の旅行でも楽かはまだわからないけど、普段履きにはいい。

da2fc98d-98ea-4eaa-a2ba-2d11ae1bb635.en: Turns out there are sneakers that fit even my super wide feet^^ I always have such a hard time choosing sneakers. If I buy based on my foot length, they're tight across the forefoot, and if I go up a size, my heels slip, so it's always tricky. Honestly, I was skeptical when I ordered these too, but I was surprised by how roomy they were across the forefoot lol I wore them to Seoul Forest with my family over the weekend, and it was nice not having my toes squished~ With my old sneakers, I'd want to take them off every so often on long walks, ugh. If you're expecting really plush cushioning, these might feel a little different, but I actually like this firm, supportive feel. I haven't worn them for over a month yet, but I'm really happy with them so far^^ I'm tempted by the other colors too~
da2fc98d-98ea-4eaa-a2ba-2d11ae1bb635.ja: こんなに幅広な私の足にも合うスニーカーがあったんだね^^ スニーカー選びは毎回本当に悩むほう。足の長さに合わせると幅がきついし、ワンサイズ上げるとかかとがパカパカして、いつもしっくりこなかった。今回も正直半信半疑で注文したけど、思ったより幅にゆとりがあってびっくり笑 週末に家族とソウルの森に行ったときに履いたけど、足の指が圧迫される感じもなくてよかった～前のスニーカーは長く歩くと途中で何度も脱ぎたくなっていたから涙 すごくふかふかのクッションを期待するとちょっと違うかもしれないけど、私はむしろこういうしっかり支えてくれる感じが好き。まだ一か月以上履いたわけじゃないけど、今のところ本当に満足^^ ほかの色も欲しくなる～

ff3d8416-ee3e-4a9c-963f-9a4cc97be1a6.en: I wear 270 in Nike and 265 in New Balance. My feet are on the wide side, and my usual workout split is about 70 weights and 30 cardio. I ordered 260, and there's a comfortable amount of extra length, with plenty of room across the forefoot. I need to tighten the laces a little to keep my feet secure. My old running shoes had cushioning that was too squishy for lower-body workouts, which was uncomfortable, but these feel firmer underfoot. I think they look better in person than in the photos. The color doesn't stand out too much for everyday wear either. One downside is that the front of the shoe looks a little wide, which might not be everyone's thing.
ff3d8416-ee3e-4a9c-963f-9a4cc97be1a6.ja: Nikeは270、New Balanceは265を履いている。足幅は広めで、普段の運動はウェイト70、有酸素30くらい。260を注文したけど、長さは程よく余裕があって幅も楽。紐を少し締めると足がしっかり固定される。今までのランニングシューズは下半身のトレーニングをするときにクッションが柔らかすぎてやりづらかったけど、これはソールがもう少ししっかりしている。デザインは写真より実物のほうがいいと思う。普段履きでもそこまで浮かない色。欠点はつま先側が少し広く見えるので、好みが分かれそうなところ。

3c73e249-fa76-45b1-a725-b8cab4fa3f0b.en: I have high insteps, and finding shoes is seriously so hard, ughhh. I usually wear 245 but ordered 240, and they're comfortable once I loosen the laces a little over my insteps!!! My toes aren't squished either, and the color is pretty, so I'm happy so far🥹 Maybe there's just a tiny bit of extra length at the front? But it doesn't bother me when I walk haha
3c73e249-fa76-45b1-a725-b8cab4fa3f0b.ja: 甲高なんだけど、本当に靴選びが大変すぎる涙涙 普段は245で240を注文したら、甲の部分の紐を少し緩めると楽！！！足の指も圧迫されないし、色までかわいくて今のところ満足🥹 つま先の長さはほんの少し余る感じ？でも歩くときに不便はない笑

01ba5c73-3247-4455-9f7f-b6ec2bcbe5b7.en: I work out 3 times a week at F45. With workouts where you're constantly switching movements, like burpees and squats, I've realized shoe choice matters more than I thought. I used to wear running shoes, but I felt a little unstable when landing after jumps. With DARIMATI, I like the feeling of my whole sole making contact with the floor. I'm especially happy with them for side-to-side movements. I've only worn them twice so far, so I can't speak to durability. They also aren't the kind of shoes that feel really light. I think they're worth trying if you do both workouts and light running.
01ba5c73-3247-4455-9f7f-b6ec2bcbe5b7.ja: 週3回F45に通っている。バーピーやスクワットみたいに動きが次々変わる運動をしていると、靴選びが思ったより大事だと感じる。前はランニングシューズを履いていたけど、ジャンプから着地するときに少し不安定な感じがあった。DARIMATIは足裏全体が床につく感じがいい。特に横に動く動作では個人的に満足。まだ二回しか履いていないので耐久性はわからない。それと、すごく軽く感じるタイプの靴ではない。トレーニングと軽いランニングを両方する人なら、一度履いてみてもよさそう。

5280e5e3-1723-48e2-9ee9-8c7bbbb2a337.en: OYSTER GREY is seriously so pretty lol White sneakers felt like too much to deal with, and I already have too many black ones, so I picked these. They look good with jeans too.
5280e5e3-1723-48e2-9ee9-8c7bbbb2a337.ja: OYSTER GREYの色、本当にかわいい笑 白いスニーカーは気を使うし、黒は持っているものが多すぎるからこれにしたけど、ジーンズにもよく合う

f4be0588-c3f3-49e7-b750-fcd95a175513.en: I've only been going to the gym for two months, and it turns out I picked the wrong shoes right from the start lol My feet kept feeling wobbly when I did squats in my usual running shoes, so I looked around and found DARIMATI! The shoes have a pretty unusual shape, but I liked OYSTER GREY, so I went with them haha So far, my feet feel less wobbly during lower-body workouts than before!! I also tried about 15 minutes on the treadmill, and that was fine too. But these aren't super plush shoes. I actually like them better this way🤍
f4be0588-c3f3-49e7-b750-fcd95a175513.ja: ジムに通い始めてまだ二か月だけど、そもそもスニーカー選びから間違ってた笑笑 いつものランニングシューズでスクワットすると足がぐらつく感じがして、調べていたらDARIMATIを知った！靴の形はちょっと独特だけど、OYSTER GREYの色がかわいくて選んだ笑 とりあえず下半身のトレーニング中は前より足裏がぐらつかない感じ！！トレッドミルも15分くらいやってみたけどよかった。ただ、ものすごくふかふかの靴ってわけじゃない。私はむしろこっちのほうが好き🤍

388681d3-1442-4cf2-ac71-abce0360d047.en: I walk a lot and go to the gym on weekends. I got tired of switching between two pairs of sneakers, so I looked around and bought these. At first, I chose them just for the design, but after trying them on, my favorite thing is how comfortable the front of my feet feel. My feet are on the wide side, and some shoes squeeze my little toes on long walks. These feel less cramped. The heels did feel a little loose at first, though, so I retied the laces. I think they'll be fine as long as you choose the right size.
388681d3-1442-4cf2-ac71-abce0360d047.ja: 普段からよく散歩をして、週末はジムに行く。スニーカー二足を履き分けるのが面倒で、探していて買った。最初はデザインだけで選んだけど、履いてみたらつま先側が楽なのが一番気に入った。私は幅広で、長く歩くと小指が圧迫される靴もあるけど、これはそういう窮屈さが少ない。ただ、かかと側は最初少し緩い気がして紐を結び直した。サイズさえうまく選べばよさそう。

6c97510b-410e-455a-9939-a54a72086073.en: My ankles are on the weak side, so I pay a lot of attention to the soles when buying shoes. I've had shoes that were actually uncomfortable because they were too soft, but these are pretty firm. I've only tried them for machine workouts and walking on the treadmill, and they were fine. I'll wear them a bit more before making up my mind.
6c97510b-410e-455a-9939-a54a72086073.ja: 足首が弱いほうなので、靴を買うときはソールをよく見る。柔らかすぎると逆に履きづらいことがあったけど、これはしっかりしているほう。マシンでのトレーニングとトレッドミルでのウォーキングくらいしか試していないけど、問題なかった。もう少し履いてから判断しようと思う。

7f4b341a-5e1a-438d-a29e-687ad3a82d86.en: I bought these for the gym, but I was surprised by how much better they go with everyday clothes than I expected lol They're cute with workout clothes, but they look good with wide-leg pants too. I guess the downside is that the light color will probably show dirt pretty easily? haha Oh, and they looked big at first, but once I put them on, they weren't as bulky-looking as I expected!
7f4b341a-5e1a-438d-a29e-687ad3a82d86.ja: ジムで履こうと思って買ったけど、思った以上に普段着に合ってびっくり笑笑 トレーニングウェアに合わせてもかわいいけど、ワイドパンツに合わせてもいい感じ。欠点は色が明るいから汚れるとちょっと目立ちそうなところ？笑 あと最初は靴が大きく見えたけど、実際履いてみるとそこまで気にならなかった！

1c2621fc-c016-4353-a94f-a9c456aebf96.en: I have flat feet and wide feet, so I'm always careful about buying shoes. I mostly wore Skechers and New Balance, and I used Nike running shoes for workouts. I got interested in DARIMATI after reading that they could be used for both running and strength training. I usually wear 250~255 and ordered 250. There's room around my toes, and the fit over my insteps was fine once I adjusted the laces. They feel firmer underfoot than my old sneakers. I walked on the treadmill for about 20 minutes and tried the leg press, and I was happy with them. If you prefer sneakers with soft cushioning, though, these might feel a little unfamiliar at first. I'm going to wear them for a few more days too.
1c2621fc-c016-4353-a94f-a9c456aebf96.ja: 偏平足で足幅も広いので、靴はいつも慎重に選ぶほう。主にSkechersとNew Balanceを履いていて、運動するときはNikeのランニングシューズを使っていた。DARIMATIはランニングと筋トレの両方に使えるという説明を見て気になった。普段は250~255を履いていて、250を注文。つま先にはゆとりがあって、甲も紐を調整したら大丈夫だった。ソールは今まで履いていたスニーカーよりしっかりした感じ。トレッドミルで20分くらい歩いてレッグプレスもやってみたけど、個人的には満足。ただ、クッションが柔らかいスニーカーが好きな人は、最初は少し違和感があるかもしれない。私もあと何日か履いてみようと思う。

ce3affe0-2c23-4e71-b7d8-da981f6119d2.en: I bought these for a trip~ I usually wear 240, and I heard they run big, so I went back and forth but ended up getting 240. They're roomy and comfortable across the forefoot. My feet are pretty thin, though, so I do feel like there's extra space at the front. I haven't walked in them for a long time yet, but they were fine for a walk around the neighborhood. I like the color too^^
ce3affe0-2c23-4e71-b7d8-da981f6119d2.ja: 旅行で履こうと思って購入～普段は240だけど、大きめの作りと聞いて迷った末に240にした。足幅はゆとりがあって楽。ただ、私の足はちょっと薄いほうなので、つま先側の空間が余る感じはある。まだ長時間は歩いていないけど、近所の散歩では問題なかった。色も気に入ってる^^

8878c172-ec4a-470f-b539-f767dcfd80d6.en: Ahh the color is seriously so pretty, I could cry. I wanted SAND BEIGE sneakers and spent ages looking before choosing these, and in person they look closer to cream!! I usually wear 235, but I ordered 230. My feet are on the wide side, so I love that they're not tight at the front lol I bought them for workouts, but they look so good with jeans that I'll probably just wear them every day🥹🤍
8878c172-ec4a-470f-b539-f767dcfd80d6.ja: ああ、本当に色がかわいすぎる涙涙 ベージュのスニーカーが欲しくてかなり探してこれにしたけど、実物を見るとクリーム色に近い感じ！！普段は235で、230を注文。幅広のほうだけど、つま先側がきつくなくていい笑笑 運動用に買ったけど、ジーンズにすごく合うからもう毎日履きそう🥹🤍

541c336e-9d33-4da3-a4bc-af09978a2788.en: I bought them for the color, but they feel pretty decent on too. I usually wear them for walks and light exercise. They're comfortable with plenty of room across the forefoot, though the shoes themselves do look a little big.
541c336e-9d33-4da3-a4bc-af09978a2788.ja: 色で選んで買ったけど、履き心地も悪くない。普段の散歩や軽い運動のときに履いている。幅にゆとりがあって楽だけど、靴自体が少し大きく見える感じはある。

acf3202d-db84-48e1-b75d-19e477851789.en: I usually wear sneakers for a long time once I buy them, so I compared several brands before getting these. I mostly use the machines at the gym, then walk on the treadmill for about 30 minutes afterward. My old shoes were narrow at the front, so my toes felt cramped after workouts, but these have a little more space. The cushioning is firmer than I expected, and I'm happy with it. My one issue is the sizing. I usually wear 265, and after debating between 260 and 270, I chose 260. The length is fine, but they feel a little tight over my insteps with thick socks. I wish they came in 265 too.
acf3202d-db84-48e1-b75d-19e477851789.ja: もともとスニーカーは一度買うと長く履くほうなので、いろいろなブランドを比べてから購入した。主にジムでマシンを使ったトレーニングをして、終わったらトレッドミルで30分くらい歩いている。前の靴はつま先側が狭くて運動後に足の指が窮屈な感じがあったけど、これはもう少し空間にゆとりがある。クッションは思ったよりしっかりしていて、個人的には満足。惜しいのはサイズ選び。普段は265を履いていて、260と270で迷った末に260を選んだ。長さは大丈夫だけど、厚手の靴下を履くと甲が少しきつく感じる。265もあったらいいのに。

f6c3bc76-068e-4108-92cb-1c9b1c4ab9a5.en: Leaving this here because I figure people with wide feet will have a hard time deciding on a size haha I wear 250 in Nike and 245 in New Balance, but I ordered 240 in DARIMATI! At first, I worried 240 might be too small, but there's more room around my toes than I expected. I did have to loosen the laces a bit over my insteps to get comfortable~ I tried a lower-body workout at the gym, and they were fine since they're not too soft underfoot. I do think sizing will depend on your foot shape!!
f6c3bc76-068e-4108-92cb-1c9b1c4ab9a5.ja: 幅広の人はサイズでかなり迷うと思うので書いておく笑 私はNikeが250、New Balanceが245だけど、DARIMATIは240を注文！最初は240だと小さすぎないか心配だったけど、つま先側は思ったより余裕がある。ただ、甲は紐を少し緩めたほうが楽だった～ジムで下半身のトレーニングをしてみたけど、ソールも柔らかすぎなくてよかった。サイズは足の形によって違いそうではある！！

8a30ea75-e2b2-4cca-8782-2c0d973b01e8.en: I run a cafe, and I'm often on my feet for more than 8 hours a day. I've always looked for sneakers with plush cushioning, but DARIMATI feels a little different. At first, they were firmer underfoot than I expected, and I wondered if I'd made the wrong choice. After wearing them for a few days, I do like that they don't squeeze the front of my feet. On days when I stand for a long time, the bottoms of my feet sometimes feel a little tired, so I think I need to wear them more to see. I usually wear 245 but bought 240, and the length doesn't really bother me. I'm happy with the design. One small downside is that, since they're SAND BEIGE, the fronts get dirty easily when I wear them at the cafe.
8a30ea75-e2b2-4cca-8782-2c0d973b01e8.ja: カフェを経営していて、一日に8時間以上立っている日が多い。これまではクッションがふかふかのスニーカーばかり選んで履いていたけど、DARIMATIは少し違う感じ。最初はソールが思ったより硬くて、買い物を失敗したかなと思った。何日か履いてみて、足の前のほうが締めつけられないところは気に入っている。長く立っている日は足裏が少し疲れることもあるので、もう少し履いてみないとわからない。普段は245で240を購入したけど、長さで特に困ることはない。デザインには満足。ただ、SAND BEIGEなので店で履いているとつま先側がすぐ汚れるのは少し残念。

05a9084f-3284-4c89-acd1-bc63ba81960b.en: I usually wear 250. I have average insteps and fairly narrow feet. I bought 250, and there's a lot of extra room at the front. My feet feel like they move around a little inside the shoes during workouts, so I tighten the laces. I like the design and color, but going down a size might have been better for my feet. If you have narrow feet, I'd suggest checking the sizing carefully.
05a9084f-3284-4c89-acd1-bc63ba81960b.ja: 普段は250を履いている。甲の高さは普通で、足幅は狭いほう。250を買ったけど、足の前のほうにかなり余裕を感じる。運動中に靴の中で足が少し動く感じがあるので、紐を締めて履いている。デザインと色は気に入っているけど、私の足にはワンサイズ小さいほうがよかったかもしれない。幅が狭い人はサイズをよく確認したほうがいいと思う。

0c8ef43a-e13a-495c-bd1f-8631ff08f800.en: My insteps are on the high side, but these are fine once I adjust the laces. The cushioning is more firm than plush. After a few days, I'm getting more used to them than when I first put them on~
0c8ef43a-e13a-495c-bd1f-8631ff08f800.ja: 甲高のほうだけど、紐を調整したら大丈夫。クッションはふかふかというよりしっかりしている感じ。最初に履いたときより何日かたったほうが馴染んできた～

8cb480ab-cfc3-46d4-9c89-7a5c64dfba2c.en: I found out about these because some people at my gym wear them for workouts. I thought they looked cute, so I looked them up, and I bought them after reading they could be used for both running and weights. I have flat feet and fairly wide feet, so finding shoes is tricky for me. Compared with my other workout shoes: running shoes (good cushioning, but a little squishy for weights) / training shoes (firm underfoot, but too narrow and uncomfortable) / DARIMATI (roomy across the forefoot and moderately firm underfoot). I bought 240, and the size fit well. I walked on the treadmill for about 15 minutes after my personal training session, and they were fine. They were a little tight over my insteps at first, so I retied the laces. My one complaint is that they almost feel too nice to only wear for workouts? lol I'm going to try wearing them casually too.
8cb480ab-cfc3-46d4-9c89-7a5c64dfba2c.ja: 通っているジムで運動するときに履いている人たちがいて知った。スニーカーがかわいくて調べてみたら、ランニングとウェイトの両方に使える靴ということで購入。私は偏平足で幅広なので、靴選びにはかなり苦労する。今までの靴と比べると、ランニングシューズ（クッションはいいけど、ウェイトをするときは少し柔らかすぎる感じ） / トレーニングシューズ（ソールはしっかりしているけど、幅が狭くて窮屈） / DARIMATI（幅にゆとりがあって、ソールは程よくしっかりしている）240を買って、サイズはぴったりだった。PTが終わってからトレッドミルで15分くらい歩いたけど問題なし。甲の部分は最初少しきつくて紐を結び直した。一つ惜しいところは、運動だけに履くにはちょっともったいないこと？笑 普段も履いてみようと思う。

5bb48b28-b41e-4a70-9ca9-37dd4a2499d8.en: My sneakers always wear down on the outside first. So I pay attention to the soles, and so far I like how firm they feel underfoot. I've been wearing these every day to walk my dog. I usually wear 235 but ordered 230, and the length fits well. They do feel a little tight over the top of my foot, so I tied the laces loosely. I like the design more than I expected.
5bb48b28-b41e-4a70-9ca9-37dd4a2499d8.ja: スニーカーを履くと必ず外側からすり減る。だから靴底はわりと気にするけど、まず履いてみてソールがしっかりしている感じはいい。犬の散歩で毎日履いてる。普段235で230を注文したけど、長さはちょうどいい。ただ、甲が少し締め付けられる気がして、ひもは緩めに結んだ。デザインは思った以上に気に入ってる。

ffc0c585-c07c-40d7-b5f2-e5a91a8fe7a8.en: I've tried so many sneakers, but finding shoes that fit my feet is really hard. I've sprained my ankles a few times before, so when I buy shoes, I pay more attention to how stable they feel underfoot than to the cushioning. My old shoes were light and comfortable underfoot, but sometimes felt a little unstable during workouts. When I first put on DARIMATI, the cushioning felt firmer than I expected, but personally, feeling supported matters more to me, so I was happy with that. I usually wear 240 and ordered the same size, but there's a little extra room in both the length and width. I thought about exchanging them for 230, but the width is comfortable as is, so I decided to keep them and wear thick socks. I mainly use them for machine workouts and light walking at the gym. Shoes alone probably won't solve my ankle issues, but I like how stable these feel when I'm wearing them. If you like a snug fit, though, I'd choose your size carefully.
ffc0c585-c07c-40d7-b5f2-e5a91a8fe7a8.ja: 本当にいろんなスニーカーを履いてきたけど、自分の足に合う靴を見つけるのはなかなか難しい。以前何度か足首をひねったことがあるので、靴を買うときはクッション性よりソールの安定感を重視するほう。今まで履いていたものは足裏が楽で軽かったけど、運動中に少し不安定に感じることがあった。DARIMATIは初めて履いたとき、思ったよりクッションが硬めだと感じたけど、個人的には足を支えてくれる感じのほうが大事なので満足。サイズは普段240で同じサイズを注文したけど、長さも幅も少し余裕がある。230への交換も考えたけど、幅は今のほうが楽なので、厚手の靴下を履いてそのまま使うことにした。ジムでマシンを使ったトレーニングと軽いウォーキングを中心に使ってる。靴だけで足首の問題が解決するわけではないだろうけど、履いたときの安定感は気に入ってる。ただ、足にぴったりフィットする感じが好きな人は、サイズを慎重に選んだほうがよさそう。

1300e68c-d13b-4431-8858-b956c34aef12.en: If you have high insteps, PLEASE read this!!!!!!!! Wow, I'm seriously someone who strikes out every time I buy shoes because of my high insteps, sobbb. I got 240, and for once they don't press down on the tops of my feet!!! I'm so happy about this lolllll. I don't have to tie the laces super tight either, and the shoes don't look as big as I expected. At first I did wonder if there was a little too much room in the front!! But once I tied the laces and walked around, they were fine. They're cute, so I'm happy for now🥹❤️
1300e68c-d13b-4431-8858-b956c34aef12.ja: 甲高の人、お願いだから見て!!!!!!!! いや本当に、靴を買うたびに甲のせいで毎回失敗する私なんだけど、泣泣泣 240を買ったら、とりあえず甲が押されない!!! これが感激すぎる笑笑笑 ひももきつく結ばなくていいし、思ったより靴も大きく見えない。でも最初はつま先がちょっと余るかな？って思った!! それでもひもを結んで歩いたら大丈夫だった。とりあえずかわいいから満足🥹❤️

78068b63-9245-45a0-95e7-e0f491b8027c.en: I found out about these after seeing someone I work out with at F45 wearing them haha. I was looking for workout shoes too, and they looked so cute that I asked about them! They said they wear them for both running and weights, so I got curious 👀 The bone next to my big toe sticks out a bit, so even slightly narrow shoes are uncomfortable for me, ugh. I usually wear a half size, around 255, but I heard these run a little big, so I ordered 250. There's plenty of room across the forefoot, so they don't press on my big toe, which I love!! I wore them to class for the first time today, and they felt a bit different from my old shoes during burpees and squats. I've only worn them for one class, so I'll have to see how they go, but I really like them 🫶🏻 They look good with my workout clothes too
78068b63-9245-45a0-95e7-e0f491b8027c.ja: F45で一緒に運動している人が履いているのを見て知った笑 私も運動用の靴を探していたんだけど、デザインがかわいくて聞いてみた！ランニングにも筋トレにも履いてると言っていて気になった 👀 私は親指の横の骨が少し出ていて、靴がちょっと狭いだけでもつらい泣 普段は255くらいのハーフサイズを履いてるけど、大きめの作りだというので250を注文。幅に余裕があって、親指のあたりが圧迫されなくてよかった!! 今日のレッスンで初めて履いてみたら、バーピーやスクワットのときの感じが前の靴とちょっと違った。まだレッスンで一度履いただけだから、もう少し様子を見ないとだけど、すごく気に入ってる 🫶🏻 トレーニングウェアにもよく合う

11e66b08-3905-47b9-ba58-8b33aa3e437c.en: I started F45, and apparently you can't just wear any sneakers? lol. Between running and lifting weights, I have no idea what shoes are best🤣 I have pretty high insteps, so tying my laces tight feels way too restrictive. I'd like some room over the tops of my feet too, ugh. The grey color is so pretty🤍 Looks like they'd be great to keep wearing after a workout too!!
11e66b08-3905-47b9-ba58-8b33aa3e437c.ja: F45を始めたけど、スニーカーも適当に選んじゃダメなのかな笑 走ったり筋トレしたりするから、どんな靴がいいのかわからない🤣 甲が高めでひもをきつく結ぶとすごく窮屈だから、甲にも余裕があるといいな泣 グレーの色はすごくかわいい🤍 運動が終わってそのまま履いて出かけるのにもよさそう!!

5d307864-ab4b-435c-862f-80c3f2478ab7.en: The grey color is so pretty~ I hated how all the comfortable shoes looked clunky, but I think these would look good with jeans too haha
5d307864-ab4b-435c-862f-80c3f2478ab7.ja: グレーの色がすごくかわいい〜楽な靴はどれもごつくて嫌だったけど、これはジーンズにも合いそう笑

168935ce-59c3-4b3a-97fc-c4193a42b604.en: Because of my wide feet, I usually wear 275 in Nike and 270 in New Balance. My feet are about 265 long, but when I size for the width, there's extra room in front, and when I size for the length, my toes often get squeezed. I walk a lot on my commute and go to the gym on weekends, so I'm looking for one pair of sneakers I can wear for both. Oyster Grey looks easy to wear and seems like it would go well with everyday clothes. I've heard these run big, so I'm debating between 260 and 270. I hope I can find a size that works for wide feet without being too loose.
168935ce-59c3-4b3a-97fc-c4193a42b604.ja: 普段は足幅の関係でNikeは275、New Balanceは270を履くことが多い。足の長さは265くらいだけど、幅に合わせるとつま先が余るし、長さに合わせると足の指が圧迫されることが多い。普段の通勤でよく歩くし、週末にはジムにも行くので、一足で兼用できるスニーカーを探している。OYSTER GREYは合わせやすくて、普段着にもよく合いそう。大きめの作りだというので260と270で迷っている。幅広の足でも緩すぎないサイズを選べるといいな。

bf4bff7b-d00b-494f-a069-ba3dc5cf3a91.en: The grey looks nice. I like that they're sneakers without looking too much like gym shoes lol. White is a pain to keep clean and I already have black, so I've been looking for a color like this
bf4bff7b-d00b-494f-a069-ba3dc5cf3a91.ja: グレーの色味がいいね。スニーカーだけど、いかにもジム用の靴って感じに見えないのがいい笑 白は手入れが面倒だし、黒はもう持ってるから、こういう色を探してた

0c1c94d4-620e-4a9a-ae57-20bd1e6a08f3.en: I work on my feet all day, so I bought these while looking for comfortable sneakers. I've worn them for about a week while working in the store. The roomy width is comfortable, and the soles are nicely firm. The area over the top of my foot did feel a little stiff at first. Loosening the laces helped. They look good with black pants, and the design is easy to wear. I'll have to wear them longer to see how well they hold up.
0c1c94d4-620e-4a9a-ae57-20bd1e6a08f3.ja: 一日中立ち仕事なので、楽なスニーカーを探していて購入。お店での勤務中に一週間ほど履いた。幅が広くて楽だし、ソールもほどよくしっかりしてる。ただ、最初は甲の部分が少し硬く感じた。ひもを緩めに調整したら大丈夫だった。黒いパンツに合わせやすくて、デザインも無難。長く履いたときの耐久性は、もう少し様子を見たい。

e64c7746-276f-450c-82e4-99db86a9d799.en: Size: Usually wear Nike 275, New Balance 270. Bought DARIMATI 270. A little extra length, comfortable width. Cushioning: Not too soft, nicely firm. Weights: Fine for machines, dumbbells, and regular squats. Cardio: Fine for about 3km on the treadmill. Haven't tried long-distance running yet. Fit: Not much pressure over the top of my foot. Laces need adjusting. Downside: Heavier than I expected. I think they work well for my goal of keeping just one pair of shoes at the gym for workouts.
e64c7746-276f-450c-82e4-99db86a9d799.ja: サイズ：普段はNikeの275、New Balanceの270を着用。DARIMATIは270を購入。長さは少し余るけど幅は楽。クッション：柔らかすぎず、ほどよくしっかりしている。筋トレ：マシン、ダンベル、普通のスクワットでは問題なかった。有酸素運動：ランニングマシンで3kmくらいは大丈夫だった。長距離ランニングはまだ試していない。履き心地：甲への圧迫は少なめ。ひもの調整は必要。欠点：思っていたより重さがある。ジムに靴を一足だけ置いて運動するという目的には合っていると思う。

af99457f-fc86-44ce-9e83-bf0b0b5ab8e3.en: I requested an exchange, and they handled it really quickly. Other places take forever with exchanges . I'm going to start wearing these to work out today. I'll work out in them for about a week and leave a review
af99457f-fc86-44ce-9e83-bf0b0b5ab8e3.ja: 交換を申し込んだら本当にすぐ対応してくれた。他のところは交換がすごく遅いのに . 今日から履いて運動しに行ってみようと思う。一週間くらい履いて運動してからレビューを書くね

47605558-7783-49be-81d2-62def6689762.en: I've been running for about a month, and at first I wore these regularly just for workouts, at least 3 times a week. 04a440e7-87ec-431c-bf3f-c63d7d33f4bc.en: They're comfortable, so I've been getting good use out of them. The adjustable laces make them easy to put on and take off
04a440e7-87ec-431c-bf3f-c63d7d33f4bc.ja: 楽に履けるのでよく履いてる。ひもを調節できるので脱ぎ履きしやすい

288425cf-868a-4f13-a662-545ff4a28bd7.en: They feel really stable no matter what I use them for, and the design is cute. Great value for the money.
288425cf-868a-4f13-a662-545ff4a28bd7.ja: どんな用途でもすごく安定感があって、デザインもかわいい。コスパ最高。

50205780-e166-4483-b36d-410512731396.en: My daughter and I do HYROX together, and I'm a mom in my 50s. We tried DARIMATI sneakers first and were so happy with them that I bought another pair for my husband. The grip is really good, and they're good for running too. I'd like to order a pair for my son later if his size is available. My husband normally wears 275, but I ordered 270, and he says they fit perfectly and feel good.
50205780-e166-4483-b36d-410512731396.ja: 一緒にHYROXのトレーニングをしている娘と、50代の母親である私が先にDARIMATIのスニーカーを履いてみて大満足だったので、夫の分も追加で一足買った。グリップがすごくよくて、ランニングにもいい。今度は息子の分もサイズさえあれば注文したい。夫は普段275だけど270を注文して履いてみたら、ぴったりでいいと言ってる。

878f78a1-b6b1-4c46-a3d7-57bb08d45f53.en: I was trying to choose between a bunch of flashy running shoes when I happened to find these and bought them. Nice, clean grey 👍 My feet are on the wide side, and my usual size fits comfortably.
878f78a1-b6b1-4c46-a3d7-57bb08d45f53.ja: 派手なランニングシューズの中で迷っていたところ、たまたま知って購入。すっきりしたグレー 👍 足幅は広めだけど、普段のサイズで楽に履ける。

2351c57f-3467-44eb-a095-bf868d4988cb.en: I bought these for my son to wear running, and he says they're comfortable and he likes them
2351c57f-3467-44eb-a095-bf868d4988cb.ja: 息子がランニングするときに履くように買ってあげたら、履きやすくていいと言ってる

bb127cea-b812-4e9e-a9e8-9eb6c3ad6451.en: I gave these to my son, and he says they feel really good on and are very comfortable. I just wish there were more colors. Really nice.

5ad38e38-5cfb-4bfc-aaa6-7b1b9d6ab3bb.en: My dad usually wears size 265 because of his bunions, and he has wide feet and high insteps too. 5ad38e38-5cfb-4bfc-aaa6-7b1b9d6ab3bb.ja: 父は外反母趾のため普段265を履いていて、幅広で甲も高めなので迷った末に270を注文したら、余裕があるどころか、かかとがパカパカするほどだった。260だとぴったりすぎるかなと思って、サイズの相談＋交換の問い合わせをしたら親切に答えてくれて、交換してもらった260で今は問題なく履いてる。

d6f79c72-81d9-435b-8413-8bcaa6f43501.en: Since these are performance shoes, I wasn't expecting much from the design, but they're clean and cute. They don't come in half sizes, so even though I wear 235 in sneakers, I bought 240, and they're a little big. That's my only disappointment.
d6f79c72-81d9-435b-8413-8bcaa6f43501.ja: 機能性シューズだからデザインは期待してなかったけど、すっきりしてかわいい。中間のサイズがなくて、普段スニーカーは235だけど240を買ったので少し大きい。それだけちょっと残念。

4f6fcdd0-93c9-4b40-934c-2fbd76f007a8.en: The cushioning is good, so they don't put strain on my knees, and they're light, so I wear them a lot day to day too.

3df7571c-7e2c-45bb-aa49-cbd259678b7f.ja: これから履くね、ありがとう

503585d7-51d3-48a1-afb4-a40402d3aea9.en: I love them. For CrossFit, they keep me firmly planted with great grip and no feeling of tipping backward. When I walk or run, they feel firm but give me enough support without feeling harsh, so they're seriously comfortable

7bbeee86-10fe-4fdc-b8ee-b7a8e658a951.ja: いいね〜〜たくさん売れるといいね〜〜

90dc0998-eb37-4a2b-98c3-73a85cb4d86f.en: This is my honest review of shoes I paid for myself. Background I tend to injure my ankles pretty often, and I'd frequently get pain around my Achilles tendon or IT band after running. I'm writing this after running about 5~10km in these DARIMATI running shoes around 10 times. Pros 1. Ankle stability ★★★★★ Of all the running shoes I've worn, these feel like they hold my ankles the most securely. I used to get discomfort around my ankles or Achilles tendons when I ran several days in a row, but since wearing these, I've been able to run on consecutive days without pain so far. Personally, this is what I'm happiest with. 2. Grip ★★★★★ Compared with my previous running shoes, the grip was really good, especially on wet pavement. I can definitely feel them gripping the ground securely, and I think that also helps my ankles wobble less and feel more stable. Cons 1. Weight ★★★ The cushioning is good, but these aren't light, snappy running shoes like carbon-plated shoes. The structure supporting the ankles is pretty firm and solid overall, so I think that adds some weight. If times or speed are your top priority, you might be a little disappointed. Overall I think these running shoes are a really good fit for people who regularly run about 5~10km a day. I personally think the way to keep running long term is to keep running steadily without getting hurt and build strength, rather than focus on times. By that standard, these worked really well for me. I was looking for shoes that would let me run steadily for a long time rather than fast shoes, and these feel exactly how I wanted, so I think I'll stick with them for a while.
90dc0998-eb37-4a2b-98c3-73a85cb4d86f.ja: 自腹で買った正直なレビュー。背景 普段から足首をよく痛めるほうで、ランニングのあとにアキレス腱や腸脛靭帯のあたりが痛くなることが多かった。DARIMATIのランニングシューズを履いて、5~10kmくらいの距離を10回ほど実際に走ってから書いているレビュー。よい点 1. 足首の安定性 ★★★★★ 今まで履いたランニングシューズの中では、足首をいちばん安定して支えてくれる感じ。以前は何日か続けて走ると足首やアキレス腱のあたりに違和感が出ていたけど、この靴を履いてからは連日走っても、今のところ痛みなく走れている。個人的にはここがいちばん満足。2. グリップ力 ★★★★★ 今まで履いていたランニングシューズと比べて、特に濡れた路面でのグリップがかなりよかった。地面をしっかり捉えている感じがはっきりあって、これも足首がぶれにくく安定して感じられることにつながっている気がする。欠点 1. 重さ ★★★ クッション性はいいほうだけど、カーボンシューズのような軽くて軽快なランニングシューズではない。足首を支える構造が全体的にしっかりして硬めなので、その分ある程度の重さが出ているのだと思う。記録やスピードを最優先するなら、少し物足りないかもしれない。総評 日常的に5~10kmくらいを継続して走る人には、本当に合うランニングシューズだと思う。私は結局ランニングも、記録よりけがをせず安定して走り続けながら筋力をつけていくことが、長く続けられる方法だと考えているので、その基準では自分に本当によく合っていた。速く走れる靴よりも、安定して長く走れる靴を探していたけど、まさに欲しかった感じなので、しばらくはこの靴に落ち着きそう。

The most important things in a running towel are absorbency and portability, and this soaks up sweat with just one wipe without leaving anything behind, which feels so fresh and nice. It's thin but absorbent, and it feels really soft too. It's also compact and light, so it's really easy to carry on runs. It looks small, but unfolded, it's big enough to cover my neck and both shoulders. After trying several running towels, I've settled on the 'DARIMATI Pocket Running Towel.' You can tell the CEO is a longtime runner who understands running and put a lot of thought into making it with all the best features (which also makes me excited for DARIMATI's running shoes and other running gear). If you don't have a running towel yet or are planning to replace yours, I definitely recommend giving this a try.

9c3c784c-b91d-4818-a005-f1aa55066db4.ja: どうにも走り出す気になれなかったランニングだったけど、みんなの中で元気をもらえたし、ブランチの時間まで本当に楽しくて、充実した週末の朝を過ごせてよかった。初心者にも優しいセッション!!

3bf7971a-539e-485b-a564-719ecff88dcc.en: Started my morning off right with an easygoing run and a picnic
3bf7971a-539e-485b-a564-719ecff88dcc.ja: 無理なく楽しめるランニングとピクニックで、いい朝をスタートできた

132eef78-0f8a-4ba6-976e-096e41e82cb6.en: I had so much fun the first time that I joined for 2 weeks in a row~! I took lots of photos to remember how much fun it was, and I'm only posting now because I was going through them all :'( There were familiar faces I'd gotten close to at session 1, new people, and even people from other countries, so it was a global run~! The organizers moved between the front and back of the group and chatted with us while we ran, and once again, both the organizers and participants were so warm and made sure everyone was looked after, even those of us with a slower pace!! Session 3 is happening on 5/1, so come check it out. I'm really looking forward to it^^
132eef78-0f8a-4ba6-976e-096e41e82cb6.ja: 初めて参加して楽しかったから、2週連続で参加した〜!楽しすぎて思い出を残そうと写真をたくさん撮って、写真を選んでいたら投稿が今になっちゃった（泣）1回目に一緒に走って仲良くなった懐かしい顔もあれば、新しく来た人もいて、海外の人も来ていてグローバルなランニングだった〜!走っている間、運営の人たちが前後を行き来しながら話しかけてくれて、今回もやっぱりペースが遅くてもみんなを気にかけてくれる温かい運営のみなさんと参加者たち!!5/1にも3回目があるそうなので、みんなもぜひチェックしてね。すごく楽しみにしてる^^

2a7e9d71-d9be-4f46-9ad0-1fbdd7f6be5d.en: I was really happy with this running session! I'd been running on my own, and this was my first time joining a session like this. The atmosphere made it much easier to relax and mingle naturally than I'd expected. The pace wasn't fast either, so I could join without feeling pressured, which made the run even more fun haha. The coffee and ciabatta after the run were so good too. (I want more 😊) They take photos for you too, and they turn out really great!!! I also got to meet some nice people, so it was a really satisfying experience, and I'd join again! I'd like to attach photos, but they're over 10MB, so I can't :'(
2a7e9d71-d9be-4f46-9ad0-1fbdd7f6be5d.ja: とにかく満足度の高いランニングセッションだった!いつもは一人で走っていて、こういうランニングセッションに参加するのは初めてだったけど、思っていたよりずっと気楽に、自然に馴染める雰囲気だった。ランニングも速いペースではなかったから気負わず参加できて、おかげでもっと楽しく走れた（笑）走り終わったあとにいただいたコーヒーとチャバタもすごくおいしかった。（また食べたい😊）写真も撮ってくれるんだけど、本当にきれいに撮ってくれる!!!素敵な人たちとも知り合えて、本当に満足できる時間だったし、また参加したい!写真を添付したいけど、容量が10MBを超えていて載せられない（泣）

e0ec11a4-cb5c-4157-ba67-d218885924f1.en: This feels like the perfect thing to join when the weather's nice like it is lately. It was my first time coming to Mangwon Hangang Park for a run, and it's a great place to run with lots of other runners around!! They made sure to adjust the pace so no one fell behind, and thanks to that I finished the full 5 kilometers. You can also get to know people over a light brunch after the run. I'm planning to join again this week haha
e0ec11a4-cb5c-4157-ba67-d218885924f1.ja: 最近みたいに天気のいい日に参加するのにぴったりだと思う。Mangwon Hangang Parkに走りに来たのは初めてだったけど、走りやすいし周りにもランニングしている人が多くていい!!特に参加者が誰も遅れないようにペースを調整してくれて、おかげで5キロを無事完走できた。走り終わって軽くブランチを食べながら、みんなと仲良くなれるのもいい。私は今週も参加する予定（笑）

120484c5-e017-452a-918c-c344adf5ab99.en: A friend told me about DARIMATI Dari Club's one-day running session, so I went~! We got together for a fun warm-up and then ran 5km. Running together was definitely less tiring than running alone, and I had fun finishing the whole route. Above all, the route with views of the Han River was amazing! So relaxing haha. And here's the most important part!! I went in worried and anxious, thinking, what if I'm the only slow one and the only one who can't finish 5km? But the organizers and the people running with me took breaks with me, walked with me, and chatted with me so I wouldn't get left behind. You never have to worry about being left all alone just because you can't keep running, and that was so reassuring haha. The best!! I signed up again for this coming Sunday to get an early start to my morning too lol. Can't wait~! See you at Dari Club this Sunday~!
120484c5-e017-452a-918c-c344adf5ab99.ja: 知り合いの紹介でDARIMATIのDARI CLUBのワンデーランニングに行ってきた〜!集まって楽しく準備運動をしてから5km走るんだけど、一人で走るときよりみんなで走るほうが確かに楽で、楽しく完走できた。何よりHangangを眺めながら走るコースが最高!まさに癒やしそのもの（笑）そしていちばん大事なポイント!!5kmを走るのに自分だけ遅かったら、自分だけ完走できなかったらどうしようと心配で不安なまま行ったけど、運営の人たちも一緒に走る人たちも、一人で取り残されることがないように一緒に休んだり歩いたり話したりしてくれて、走れないからって絶対に寂しく一人で置いていかれることはないから、心配する必要もなくて本当に心強かった（笑）最高!!今度の日曜日も朝活を兼ねてまた参加を申し込んだ（笑）楽しみ〜!今週の日曜日、DARI CLUBで会おうね〜!

3f0837b0-3ab5-4c66-9b95-6b80c8d6b989.en: The Han River is near where I live, so I wanted to try running, but even 1km on my own was a struggle and felt so hard😂 I wanted to learn proper running form and things like that from a professional coach, and when I looked it up, I found a class like this right in my neighborhood..! Through the class, I got to know people in the neighborhood, and running became a hobby! I don't run that often, but I still go every now and then, and my stamina has improved enough that I can usually run 3km~5km!✨
3f0837b0-3ab5-4c66-9b95-6b80c8d6b989.ja: 近所にHangangがあるから走ってみようと思ったけど、一人では1km走るのも精いっぱいで本当にきつかった😂プロのコーチに正しいランニングフォームとかを教わりたくて調べたら、近所にこんなクラスがあった..!クラスを通して近所の人たちとも知り合えて、走ることが趣味になった!頻繁ではないけど、それでも時々走っていて、普通に3km~5kmは走れるくらい体力がついた!✨

d363eadc-71b8-4573-b567-1c216921d7ea.en: I've learned from Coach Kim Yong-taek before, and I loved how structured his coaching was! I hadn't been able to go to Banana Club because it was too far away, but now that he's holding sessions in Mangwon, I have to go~! When I first started running, my body would lean to one side. During class, the coach ran alongside me and kept checking my form, and it's changed a lot. He also helped me understand that running isn't just about your feet; you need to involve your arm swing and spine too. I especially like the supplementary strength exercises. Before taking his classes, I didn't even know those exercises existed, so whenever I got a little tired, I could barely lift my knees and would drag my feet as I ran. Since doing the exercises, I can lift my knees much higher, and I feel like I can maintain my form even on longer runs. Honestly, getting myself out the door to run is the hardest part. Just when I really needed people to run with, I heard he was coming to Mangwon-dong, so I'm signing up hoping this class will help me take on a full marathon this fall. I'd recommend it to anyone who feels unsure about their form and keeps getting aches and pains when running alone. Come learn properly from Coach Yong-taek!
d363eadc-71b8-4573-b567-1c216921d7ea.ja: 前にKim Yongtaekコーチに教わったことがあるんだけど、本当に体系立てて教えてくれてすごくよかった!実はこれまでBanana Clubは遠くて行けなかったけど、Mangwonでやるなら絶対行かなくちゃ〜!走り始めたころは体が片側に傾いていたんだよね。レッスンでコーチが一緒に走りながらずっとフォームをチェックしてくれたおかげで、かなり変わった。それに、走るのは足だけじゃなくて、腕振りや背骨まで使うものなんだってコーチを通して理解できた。特に補強トレーニングがいいと思う。教わる前は補強トレーニングがあることも知らなくて、ちょっと疲れると膝もあまり上がらず足を引きずって走っていたけど、補強トレーニングをするようになってから膝もかなり上がるし、長く走ってもフォームを保ちやすくなった気がする。正直、走りに出かけるのがいちばん大変で、一緒に走る仲間が本当に必要だったタイミングでMangwon-dongに来てくれるなんて。今回のクラスをきっかけに、この秋はフルマラソンにも挑戦するつもりで申し込む。一人で走るとフォームも不安だし、しょっちゅう体が痛くなるという人におすすめ。Yongtaekコーチにしっかり教わってみて!

5eb55e79-e9cb-40b7-a1a3-e42d5996553a.en: I've wanted to try running, but I was really worried about not having enough stamina. I'm looking forward to the class since we'll have an expert there teaching us. I'd also been checking out DARIMATI shoes on YouTube, and they're comfortable to wear, so I'm excited for the classes to start!!
5eb55e79-e9cb-40b7-a1a3-e42d5996553a.ja: ランニングをやってみたかったけど、体力が足りなくてすごく心配だった。専門家までついて教えてくれるというから、クラスが楽しみ。DARIMATIのシューズもYouTubeで見ていたんだけど、履き心地がよくてレッスンが始まるのが楽しみ!!

973d1e35-69b9-44a3-b89d-2c61660f5d0b.ja: 最近周りでランニングする人が増えてきて、自分もやってみようかなと思っていたところに、こんな初心者向けセットがあったので購入。ランニングシューズに帽子、ベルト、タオル、シューズバッグまで全部ついて10万ウォン台で、本当に安く買えたと思う。初めて履いたとき、かかとと甲をしっかりホールドしてくれる感じがすごくよかった。緩すぎず、締めつけすぎず、本当にちょうど必要な分だけ。ランニングシューズらしく軽くて、クッションがしっかり支えてくれるから長く歩いても足が疲れにくかった。運動するとき、ほかの紐つきの靴は紐がぶらぶらして、そのうちほどけることがよくあって、運動に集中できず靴が気になっていた。でもDARIMATIのランニングシューズは紐を結ぶ方式ではなく、締めたり緩めたりする方式で、甲のところに調節するパーツがついているのがすごくよかった。色やデザインもほかのランニングシューズみたいに派手ではなく、シンプルで普段履きにもいいね。すごく満足して履いている〜
